beats.care: Drought shrinks harvests, which can push up prices of rice, vegetables and pulses you buy. Food inflation already hit 7.74% in September.
beats.what: Karnataka has declared 217 of its 240 taluks drought-hit, and Andhra Pradesh 388 mandals. Central teams are now checking the damage.
beats.why: The Hindu's editorial says that once those teams report, the Centre must release drought support quickly instead of leaving states waiting.

cards.body: After the monsoon retreats, states count their losses and the Centre sends teams to verify them. The editorial's point is about timing: as soon as those findings are in, the Centre should release its support, not sit on it.
cards.title: Drought report: on southwest monsoon, drought in Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh
cards.verdict: Bottom line: once the damage is verified, drought relief should not wait.

cards.body: India's monsoon ended about 13% below normal this year, and about 70.6% of the country faced dry or drought conditions, per IIT Gandhinagar's drought monitor. Maharashtra has declared drought in 265 of 358 talukas, and Telangana is about 17% short.
Its worst southwest monsoon in 55 years. The state estimates losses could reach ₹50,000 to ₹60,000 crore.
cards.caption: Karnataka's monsoon rain shortfall

cards.body: Andhra Pradesh's chief minister says that even during this drought, about 2,000 TMC of river water is flowing into the sea.
